summary: A Kogarah practice claiming 20 years of experience appears to lose enquiries to empty sections and missing hours.

findings.problem: The denture section appears to show three headings with no text under any of them, and the testimonials area appears to show one image with no quotes.
findings.cost: Empty sections make the practice look unfinished and give no proof.
findings.fix: Real descriptions and real patient quotes.

findings.problem: No opening hours appear, and two phone numbers appear with no note on which to use.
findings.cost: Patients cannot tell when to call or which line to use.
findings.fix: Visible hours and one clear number.

findings.problem: Health fund logos appear to be blank grey placeholders, and image labels appear to be raw file names.
findings.cost: Placeholders look unfinished and hurt search visibility.
findings.fix: Real logos and proper image labels.

findings.problem: The email domain appears to differ from the website domain, and the page says affordable with only whitening prices.
findings.cost: Mismatched domains and vague pricing reduce trust.
findings.fix: A matching email domain and clearer pricing.
